veuxEnfant.introTexte: Twenty questions about how you feel when you think about having a child, and about what holds you back. The two are measured separately, because you can really want a child and have lots of fears at the same time. There's no right answer: answer for yourself, not for your family.
veuxEnfant.resultatLibelle: Your wish and your doubts, in two measures
veuxEnfant.p_fini_t: A life without kids suits you
veuxEnfant.p_fini_d: You don't feel any particular wish to have a child, and it isn't fear holding you back: you're simply happy as you are. It's a life choice like any other, and you're far from the only one.
veuxEnfant.p_fini_a: If you're in a relationship, the most important thing is to talk about it early and clearly with your partner: it's a subject where you can't meet halfway. And if people keep telling you “it'll come”, you're allowed to think it won't.
veuxEnfant.p_attachement_d: For now, what holds you back weighs more than the wish. That doesn't mean you don't want children, or that you do: maybe it's not the right time, or the fear is taking up all the room and hiding the rest.
veuxEnfant.p_attachement_a: Try to sort it out: what would change if money, your relationship or work weren't an issue? If the wish comes back when the obstacles disappear, it's the obstacles talking. If nothing comes back, maybe a life without children is what suits you.
veuxEnfant.p_amour_d: Your answers point the same way: you can picture yourself with a child, and what holds you back weighs less than the wish. Everyone has fears, but yours don't take over.
veuxEnfant.p_amour_a: If you're in a relationship, the next step is to talk about it together, simply: does your partner want the same thing, at the same time? And if you're not, this wish still has every right to exist.
veuxEnfant.p_deux_t: A real wish, and real fears
veuxEnfant.p_deux_d: You want a child, and at the same time lots of things scare you: money, tiredness, the idea of getting it wrong. That's very common! Wanting and doubting often go together, precisely because it's a decision that matters.
veuxEnfant.p_deux_a: Look at your fears one by one, on paper. Some can be solved with planning (money, housing, work), others need talking about (the fear of repeating what you went through). The wish itself can't be manufactured: you have it.
veuxEnfant.p_melange_d: Your wish and your doubts roughly balance out. You don't know yet whether you want a child or not, and that's a very honest place to be. Lots of people stay in between for years, until life tips the scale.
veuxEnfant.p_melange_a: There's no rush if you can wait. Take this quiz again in a few months, in a relationship or not: if the answer moves, you'll see which way. And talk to parents and to people without kids, to hear both sides.
veuxEnfant.q1: When you picture your life in ten years, is there a child in it?
veuxEnfant.q1a: Yes, I can see it clearly
veuxEnfant.q2: The fear of losing your freedom (nights out, travel, lie-ins)?
veuxEnfant.q3: A friend hands you their baby. How do you feel?
veuxEnfant.q3a: I melt, I want to hold them for a while
veuxEnfant.q3c: I don't really know what to do
veuxEnfant.q3d: I can't wait to hand them back
veuxEnfant.q4: Money, when you think about having a child?
veuxEnfant.q4a: It's a real obstacle, I don't see how we'd manage
veuxEnfant.q5: A whole life without children: how does that feel?
veuxEnfant.q5a: It would make me sad, something would be missing
veuxEnfant.q6: The fear of being a bad parent, or of repeating what you went through?
veuxEnfant.q7: Do you ever imagine baby names, a nursery, family trips?
veuxEnfant.q8: Your job, your studies or your plans: would a child fit in right now?
veuxEnfant.q8a: No, it would put everything on hold
veuxEnfant.q8c: With a bit of planning, yes
veuxEnfant.q9: Passing something on (values, a family story, a recipe): does that matter to you?
veuxEnfant.q10: The state of the world (climate, the future) when you think about having a child?
veuxEnfant.q10c: I think about it a little
veuxEnfant.q11: Friends tell you they're expecting a baby. Your first thought?
veuxEnfant.q11a: I so wish it were my turn
veuxEnfant.q11b: I'm happy for them, and I picture myself in their place a bit
veuxEnfant.q11c: I'm happy for them, that's all
veuxEnfant.q11d: I wouldn't want to be in their shoes
veuxEnfant.q12: The tiredness, the short nights, the body changing?
veuxEnfant.q13: Can you see yourself as a parent day to day: bedtime stories, homework, weekends at the park?
veuxEnfant.q13b: Yes, part of it appeals to me
veuxEnfant.q14: Your relationship today: is it solid enough to welcome a child?
veuxEnfant.q14a: I'm not in a relationship, or I have doubts about us
veuxEnfant.q14b: There are things to sort out first
veuxEnfant.q15: Other people's kids, at a restaurant or at friends' houses?
veuxEnfant.q15c: I can put up with them for a while
veuxEnfant.q16: Are you afraid of regretting your choice, one way or the other?
veuxEnfant.q17: If you found out you could never have children, how would it feel?
veuxEnfant.q17b: Hard, but I'd get over it
veuxEnfant.q18: The days of the parents around you: do they make you want it, or scare you?
veuxEnfant.q19: Your wish for a child, when it's there: where does it come from?
veuxEnfant.q19b: Partly from me, partly from people around me
veuxEnfant.q19c: Mostly from my partner or my family
veuxEnfant.q20: You find out tomorrow that you're going to have a baby. Your first reaction?
veuxEnfant.q20a: This is not the right time at all
veuxEnfant.q20c: Joy, with a bit of stress
